utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already — folks are bringing tools, parts, and plenty of good energy. I can swing by later and see if they still need another pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Is that confirmed, or just rumor? If they still need help, I might stop by too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s just what I’ve been hearing around the block, so I wouldn’t call it confirmed yet. I’ll check in later and let you know if they still need help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll keep sharing the repair drive plan with folks nearby and make sure everyone knows what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you keeping everyone in the loop. I’ll try not to miss the updates this time.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep passing the repair drive updates along, and if anything changes I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what needs fixing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking the list, but I know the driveway and one of the loose fence posts need attention.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I can help with the driveway and the fence post. Just send me the full list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard much yet, but I’m glad folks are organizing it. If you want, I can keep an ear out for any updates.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — that’d be a big help. I’m keeping track of what we still need, and I’ll let you know as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — just send me a note if you need anything else, and I’ll keep listening for updates.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule. What time is the repair drive happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — I’m aiming for late Saturday morning so folks can swing by after drop-off. I’ll send the final time once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me — once you lock the time, I can help spread the word around school.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I like a clear plan for the repair drive—what’s the schedule, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry—I’m still putting the plan together. I’ll send you the schedule soon, and if you could bring your toolbox and a roll of tape, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me—just send the schedule when it’s ready, and I’ll bring my toolbox and tape.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, I’m in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. If you’ve got the details, I can invite a few neighbors today.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — that helps a lot. I’ll send you the details now, and maybe we can keep it simple so everyone knows where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — send me the time and place, and I’ll start inviting folks right away. Keep it simple, and I’ll make sure the neighbors hear about it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive is getting started soon — is there anything you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s so kind of you, Nell — I could use help making a list of the homes that need repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I can help with that. Just point me to the homes you already know about, and I’ll start listing them.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m listening — can you share the repair drive details one more time so I’ve got them right before I act?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m happy to go over them again. I’ll keep it simple and make sure you have the repair drive details straight before you do anything.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — please tell me the date, time, and where to bring it, and I’ll make sure I have it right.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Totally fair — thanks for offering what you can. I’ll keep it low-key and loop you in if anything simple comes up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Dane. Just send me the simple stuff when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring a few tools over for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. What time should I expect you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 3 this afternoon — that work for you?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I haven’t mapped the repair drive yet, but I can keep track of where we need to go.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, that works for me — just keep me posted on the stops and I’ll follow along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Will do — I’ll note each stop and keep you updated as we go.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand with the repair drive—I've got a few tools if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’d be really helpful, Gus. I appreciate it—maybe I can swing by and see what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—drop by anytime and we’ll see what you need. I’ve got a few basics ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the schedule and where we’re dropping things off first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, that makes sense — do we have the schedule confirmed yet, and where’s the first drop-off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet, but I’d feel better once we have the time locked in and the first stop confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to pass along?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Jules — could you pass along that we need a few extra volunteers for tool check-in and light fixing help? I’ll have the details ready soon.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that you need a few extra volunteers for tool check-in and light fixing help. Send me the details when you have them, and I’ll pass them along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep an eye on supplies for the repair drive—just let me know what you’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll let you know if we’re short on anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Of course — I’ll keep my eyes open and check in if I spot anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely — folks are pitching in more than expected. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That’s great to hear — I’m glad it’s getting such a strong turnout. Please do keep me posted, especially once the school schedule gets finalized.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as the school schedule is finalized. Seems like everything’s moving along better than we hoped!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Mostly I need help keeping the list organized and checking in with neighbors about what they can spare. If you can take that on, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I can do that. Send me the list and I’ll check in with folks about what they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what do you need help with for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help sort donations and carry boxes. Just tell me when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Leo — thank you. I’ll let you know the time and place as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, the repair drive’s getting started soon—want me to save you a spot or pass along the details?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — please pass along the details, and if there’s a spot open I’d appreciate that too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send you the details and keep an eye out for an open spot too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to track the repair drive locations—just tell me where you’re heading first.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s start at my place on Maple, then swing by the corner house and Mrs. Lee’s.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — first stop is your place on Maple, then the corner house, then Mrs. Lee’s.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — is the repair drive still on for Saturday, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m checking the details now, but I think it’s still on for Saturday. I’ll confirm what to bring as soon as I know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Hana — just let me know once you’ve confirmed, and I’ll bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like the repair drive is getting some good momentum. I’ll keep an ear out for any updates while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’d appreciate that. I’m a little forgetful, so I’m counting on you to catch anything important.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I hear anything important.
